title: Agreement at an outside cell
statement: Let $s$ be a set of integer addresses and let $m,m'$ be memories mapping integer addresses to $W$-bit words. If $m'$ agrees with $m$ at every address outside $s$, then $m'(a)=m(a)$ for every address $a$ outside $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $m'$ and $m$ agree at every address outside $s$.
